analysis:
Examined both added implementations, their patches, and the resident-runtime addition metadata and bounded orientation excerpt against the canonical index and detailed T-041 evidence. No independently supported vulnerability was established in this source scope.

Gemma4TensorParallelPrefix.swift:47-75 binds reuse to load/plan, artifact/storage/build identities and delegated request scopes; 134-150 checks restored layer geometry and dtype; 168-207 requires two-rank restoration confirmation or cold fallback. Capture at 336-391 copies sliding windows and shares bounded full-attention snapshots; 246-255 delegates resident insertion and SSD persistence. Logs expose counts/tier/budget, not prompt tokens. This adds RAM and optional durable KV retention relevant to A-001, TB-007, T-028 and T-041; the production SSD-only assumptions cannot automatically be applied to this cluster path.

Gemma4TensorParallelRequestLoop.swift:46-49 delegates prefill checks; 80-131 propagates token-stop and page-refusal flags while preserving collective ordering, and 136-148 reconciles final counts. No transport encryption, authorization, attestation or billing policy changes are visible here.

Integration must verify ClusterWorkerPrefixCache.scope receives authenticated account-bound policy, QwenStagePrefixDiskTier provides keyed names/authenticated encryption, TTL/purge and bounded staging, and the production cache gate covers this new path. Verify resident-runtime callers enforce clean two-rank retirement before store, capture charging/withdrawal, and cancellation/deadline/process teardown when one rank throws or token-channel answers stall (T-010, T-053). Gemma4TensorParallelResidentRuntime.swift has only metadata and a truncated orientation excerpt here; its implementation and these delegated contracts remain unverified. Determine whether cluster activation requires updating T-041's RAM-tier and deployment-scope assumptions rather than assuming production exposure.
